name: Foundation of Growth
description: Those that abide by the teachings of Tapu Bulu excel at finding growing life in the world, able to find berries and natural resources more easily.
effect: Devotees of the Spirit Guardian of Growth may call upon "Foundation of Growth" once per quest as a bonus action to summon Grassy Terrain. At Luminary, they may expend 1 Will when their Terrain would end for any reason. If they do so, they retain a personalized Grassy Terrain that only affects them and can exist with another Terrain. This personalized Terrain lasts for 4 Turns. Furthermore, at Luminary, they can cause their Grassy Terrain's to only heal Allies. At Paragon, as long as any Terrain is active they regain 1 HP at the start of each Round.
